paper_metadata.title: A 250-kHz 94-dB Double-Sampling Modulation A/D Converter With a Modified Noise Transfer Function
paper_metadata.abstract: This paper presents a high-order double-sampling single-loop modulation analog-to-digital (A/D) converter.
